ModMetaData.name: Free Performance
ModMetaData.author: brage
ModMetaData.description:
Makes large, late-game colonies run faster without changing how the game plays.
Every optimization gives exactly the same result as the unmodified game. The mod skips work that provably does nothing, or reuses answers that provably have not changed. Nothing is approximated, delayed or run on other threads.
Measured in a real 29-colonist colony (day 722, 202 pawns, 5,700 buildings) at Superfast: about 23% more game speed, and about 15% more on top of Performance Optimizer with 50 other mods installed. Smaller or younger colonies gain less. The wealth recount stutter every ~80 game seconds is about a third shorter.
What it does: - Pawns that stand still (sleeping, idle, working at a bench) skip the parts of their tick that cannot do anything in that state. - Health, genes and other per-pawn bookkeeping only tick what can actually change. - Plant wind sway is applied once per frame instead of once per tick. - Faster gas grid, haul destination, reservation, quest and alert checks. - Colony wealth recount values each kind of wall or conduit once, instead of every single one.
How it was tested: - Each optimization has a verify mode that runs the original game code alongside it and compares the results. All show 0 differences. - Game speed was measured with the optimizations switched on and off every 10 seconds in the same play session.
Compatibility: - Tested together with Performance Optimizer and a set of 50 popular mods. - If another mod changes a method an optimization depends on, that optimization switches itself off and says so in the log. - Saves no data into your save file, so you can add or remove it at any time.
Each optimization can be switched off under Options > Mod settings.
